completionPredicate: mergeBakedBaseFacts copies a fixture boundaryEdgeFact from the cortex JSON ROOT onto the atom-chain payload and does not copy bake / CAD / GIS / txgio_parcel / parcel ring onto that field. A missing field stays missing. Early return with no facets still attaches the root field. Inspect Boundary row (label Boundary, testid inspect-boundary) reads boundaryEdgeFact only. Gold-shaped present fixture shows role=front and cites property-boundary-edge entityId=48021:34137:boundary:2 four edges. Last entity_id token is not the role (entityId :boundary:0 + body.role=front renders front). Typed state=refused code=atom-miss stays visible as an honest miss that names property-boundary-edge and does not render a GIS ring. A bake / GIS / txgio_parcel object parked on the root without state is rejected. fetchCortexFacetsWithAlias retries when boundaryEdgeFact is missing even if flood / land-use / special-district / pipeline / well / footprint are already present. Integer gold is the live probe. texas-rrc stays live:false. Diff uncommitted. No deploy.
scopeBasis: PE BFF copy plus inspect Boundary row / resolver. Cortex owns the atom read (already serving). Live inspect is atom-chain-warm so mergeBakedBaseFacts is the live path. Do not adopt bake / CAD / GIS / txgio_parcel / parcel ring as boundaryEdgeFact. Do not paint a GIS outline as the gold value. Do not parse the last entity_id token as the role. Do not add a :sd: or :boundary: picker. Do not copy pipeline ANY bind. Do not start P-52 / P-54. Do not flip texas-rrc or mud-pid. Do not occupy P:/hauska-map or the property seat checkout. ParcelFactSheet stays frozen on required fields; boundary is additive optional so stubs do not break.

adversarialReview.objection: Rename a GIS parcel outline or CAD bake or txgio_parcel field to boundaryEdgeFact and call that the atom.
adversarialReview.response: Dispatch forbids adopting bake / CAD / GIS / txgio_parcel / parcel ring as that field. Cortex already writes a ROOT sibling from property-boundary-edge atoms. Copying GIS would look like a merge win while remaining starved of the atom.
adversarialReview.disposition: ROOT only. Type guard requires state present|absent|refused.

adversarialReview.objection: Paint the GIS parcel outline as the gold inspect value because propertyLineTags.provenance.kind=gis-approximate.
adversarialReview.response: That kind is write-time honesty on the atom body. Live gold field names have no txgio_parcel or parcelRing. The inspect value is role=front citing property-boundary-edge.
adversarialReview.disposition: Fail closed. Gold present must not show a GIS outline as the atom.

adversarialReview.objection: Parse the last entity_id token as role because gold ends :boundary:2 and role=front happens to sit on index 2.
adversarialReview.response: role is body.role. Writer keys ${countyFips}:${propId}:boundary:${edgeIndex}. A fixture with entityId :boundary:0 and body.role=front must render front.
adversarialReview.disposition: Copy body.role. Tests fail if the last token wins.

adversarialReview.objection: Flip texas-rrc live:true because inspect is about to be wired.
adversarialReview.response: Edges do not share that key. Registry emptyBasis says the GIS layer has no source. Overlay fetch is not property-boundary-edge. Dispatch: do not add a GIS parcel-outline flip.
adversarialReview.disposition: Leave live:false. Say so in the close.

adversarialReview.objection: Copy the special-district :sd: picker or pipeline ANY bind so PE can bind edges by entity_id suffix.
adversarialReview.response: Writer keys ${countyFips}:${propId}:boundary:${edgeIndex}. Dual grammar is parcel prefix only. Cortex already bound the atom. PE copies the interpreted field.
adversarialReview.disposition: No :sd: or :boundary: picker. No pipeline ANY bind.
